title: DP3431 Incomplete Pass-Through and the Welfare Effects of Exchange Rate Variability
title_zh: 不完全传递与汇率变动的福利效应
title_primary: 不完全传递与汇率变动的福利效应
title_secondary: DP3431 Incomplete Pass-Through and the Welfare Effects of Exchange Rate Variability
official: 官方在线 2002-06-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This Paper considers the implications of incomplete exchange rate pass-through for optimal monetary and exchange rate policy. A two-country model is presented which allows an explicit derivation of welfare functions in terms of a weighted sum of the second moments of producer prices and the nominal exchange rate. From a single country perspective the optimal exchange rate variance depends on the degree of pass-through, the size and openness of the economy, the elasticity of labour supply and the volatility of foreign producer prices. The optimal coordinated equilibrium can be supported by requiring national central banks to minimize loss functions, which are a weighted sum of the variances of producer prices and the exchange rate, where the weight on the exchange rate variance depends on the degree of pass-through.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了不完全汇率传递对最优货币与汇率政策的含义。通过构建两国模型，以生产者价格与名义汇率的二阶矩加权和形式明确推导出福利函数。从单一国家视角来看，最优汇率方差取决于汇率传递程度、经济体规模与开放度、劳动供给弹性以及外国生产者价格的波动性。最优协调均衡可通过要求各国央行最小化损失函数来实现，该损失函数由生产者价格方差与汇率方差的加权和构成，其中汇率方差的权重取决于汇率传递程度。

title: Nature, Nurture, and Socioeconomic Outcomes: New Evidence from Sib Pairs and Molecular Genetic Data
title_zh: 自然、教养与社会经济结果：来自兄弟姐妹对与分子遗传数据的新证据
title_primary: 自然、教养与社会经济结果：来自兄弟姐妹对与分子遗传数据的新证据
title_secondary: Nature, Nurture, and Socioeconomic Outcomes: New Evidence from Sib Pairs and Molecular Genetic Data
authors: Markel, Gareth, Ahlskog, Rafael, Ebeltoft, Joakim Coleman, Mõttus, René, Oskarsson, Sven 等
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: A consequence of Mendel’s First Law is that siblings' genetic relatedness varies randomly (with a mean of 50%). We use molecular genetic data to compute the genetic relatedness of ~80,000 sib pairs. We then compare the pairs' genetic relatedness to their similarity on 15 socioeconomic and health outcomes to estimate the relative importance of genetic (i.e., heritability) and family environmental influences on each outcome. We find evidence of sizeable genetic influences on many outcomes, including cognitive performance, fertility, risk tolerance, smoking, and subjective wellbeing, and of more limited genetic influences on educational attainment and income.
abstract_zh: 孟德尔第一定律的一个推论是，兄弟姐妹的遗传相关性随机变化（平均值为50%）。我们利用分子遗传学数据计算了约8万对兄弟姐妹的遗传相关性，随后比较这些配对在15项社会经济与健康结果上的相似性，以估算遗传（即遗传力）和家庭环境因素对每项结果的相对重要性。研究发现，许多结果（包括认知表现、生育能力、风险承受力、吸烟行为及主观幸福感）受到显著的遗传影响，而教育成就和收入受遗传影响的程度则较为有限。

title: Does public data openness curb insider trading? Evidence from China
title_zh: 公共数据开放是否抑制了内幕交易？来自中国的证据
title_primary: 公共数据开放是否抑制了内幕交易？来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Does public data openness curb insider trading? Evidence from China
authors: Dixin Wu, Juerui Feng, Lili Jiu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines whether public data openness affects insider trading behaviour and profitability. Utilizing China’s staggered municipal launch of open government data (OGD) platforms and a stacked difference-in-differences design, we find that public data openness reduces insider trading profitability. Mechanism tests reveal that OGD platforms operate through an information channel by enriching the firm-level information environment, specifically increasing analyst coverage, narrowing bid-ask spreads, and reducing stock price synchronicity. Further analyses show that OGD platforms compress insider trading on both the extensive margin (reducing overall trading likelihood) and the intensive margin (lowering the probability of trade success conditional on trading). Cross-sectional tests show that this deterrent effect is more pronounced for firms with weaker corporate governance and those located in regions with superior digital infrastructure. These findings offer insights for policymakers that public data infrastructure generates positive externalities for financial market integrity.
abstract_zh: 本文考察公共数据开放是否影响内幕交易行为及其盈利性。利用中国各城市分阶段启动政府数据开放平台的自然实验，结合堆叠双重差分模型，我们发现公共数据开放降低了内幕交易盈利水平。机制检验表明，政府数据开放平台通过信息渠道发挥作用——通过丰富企业层面的信息环境，具体表现为增加分析师关注度、缩小买卖价差以及降低股价同步性。进一步分析显示，政府数据开放平台从广延边际（降低整体交易可能性）和集约边际（降低既定交易条件下的成功概率）两个维度压缩内幕交易。截面检验表明，这种抑制效应在公司治理较弱的企业以及位于数字基础设施更优地区的企业中更为显著。这些发现为政策制定者提供了启示：公共数据基础设施能够为金融市场诚信建设产生正向外部性。

title: Twin Defaults and Bank Capital Requirements
title_zh: 双重违约与银行资本要求
title_primary: 双重违约与银行资本要求
title_secondary: Twin Defaults and Bank Capital Requirements
authors: CATERINA MENDICINO, KALIN NIKOLOV, JUAN RUBIO‐RAMIREZ, JAVIER SUAREZ, DOMINIK SUPERA
abstract: We examine optimal capital requirements in a quantitative general equilibrium model with banks exposed to nondiversifiable borrower default risk. Contrary to standard models of bank default risk, our framework captures the limited upside, but significant downside risk of loan portfolio returns. This helps to reproduce the frequency and severity of twin defaults : simultaneously high firm and bank defaults. Hence, the optimal bank capital requirement, which trades off a lower frequency of twin defaults against restricting credit provision, is higher than under default risk models which underestimate the impact of borrower default on bank solvency.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文在一个银行面临不可分散的借款人违约风险的量化一般均衡模型中，研究了最优资本要求。与标准的银行违约风险模型不同，我们的框架捕捉了贷款组合收益的有限上行空间和显著下行风险。这有助于再现双重违约（即企业与银行同时出现高违约率）的频率与严重程度。因此，最优银行资本要求在降低双重违约频率与限制信贷供给之间进行权衡，其水平高于那些低估借款人违约对银行偿付能力影响的违约风险模型所得到的结果。

title: Targeting Attitudes to Combat Sexual Harassment: A Randomized Intervention in the Norwegian Military
title_zh: 针对态度以打击性骚扰：挪威军队中的随机干预实验
title_primary: 针对态度以打击性骚扰：挪威军队中的随机干预实验
title_secondary: Targeting Attitudes to Combat Sexual Harassment: A Randomized Intervention in the Norwegian Military
authors: Olle Folke, Torbjørn Hanson, Åshild A. Johnsen, Andreas Kotsadam, Johanna Rickne
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop an information-based intervention against sexual harassment and test it in a randomized control trial across small groups of military recruits in the boot camp of the Norwegian military. The intervention seeks to bridge two knowledge gaps with implications for sexual harassment prevalence. We tell some recruits about their peers' beliefs that "telling sexualized jokes can be labeled sexual harassment" and about women soldiers' equal performance on military skill tests. This treatment gives lasting improvements in knowledge about what sexual harassment is and about women's job performance. The impact on sexual harassment prevalence is directionally negative but statistically insignificant. We discuss measurement error and use survey responses about a harassment scenario to argue that the intervention likely affected behavior. Our study provides the first field experiment to evaluate whether a prevention method against sexual harassment reduces prevalence in a work setting. We use insights from our research process to identify methodological pitfalls and provide guidance for future field experiments in this area.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于信息的性骚扰干预措施，并在挪威军队新兵训练营的小规模新兵群体中通过随机对照试验进行了测试。该干预措施旨在弥合两个与性骚扰发生率相关的认知差距。我们向部分新兵告知其同伴认为“讲黄色笑话可被视为性骚扰”的观点，以及女兵在军事技能测试中表现同样出色的信息。这一干预措施显著提升了受试者对性骚扰定义及女性工作表现的认知，且效果具有持续性。干预对性骚扰发生率的影响呈负向趋势，但未达到统计显著性。我们讨论了测量误差问题，并利用关于骚扰情境的问卷调查结果论证该干预措施可能影响了实际行为。本研究提供了首个通过实地实验评估工作场所性骚扰预防措施有效性的证据。我们基于研究过程中的洞察识别了方法论陷阱，并为该领域未来的实地实验提供了指导建议。

title: Work Under Attack: Terrorism and Local Labor Markets
title_zh: 遭受攻击下的工作：恐怖主义与地方劳动力市场
title_primary: 遭受攻击下的工作：恐怖主义与地方劳动力市场
title_secondary: Work Under Attack: Terrorism and Local Labor Markets
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: How does terrorism affect labor markets in developing countries? We combine georeferenced data on terrorist incidents with nationally representative employment data from Nigeria to examine this question. Exploiting within-location variation in exposure to terrorist attacks over time, we show that terrorism reduces employment. A one standard deviation increase in exposure lowers the probability of employment by 0.7 percentage points, or roughly 1 percent of average employment, with substantially larger effects for women. Beyond reducing employment, terrorism shifts workers away from regular and cash-paying jobs and lowers employment in sales, services, and unskilled manual occupations. The findings identify labor market disruption as an important economic cost of insecurity in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 恐怖主义如何影响发展中国家的劳动力市场？我们将恐怖袭击的地理参照数据与尼日利亚具有全国代表性的就业数据相结合来研究这一问题。通过利用同一地区在不同时期遭受恐怖袭击暴露程度的差异，我们发现恐怖主义会降低就业水平。恐怖袭击暴露程度每增加一个标准差，就业概率将下降0.7个百分点（约占平均就业率的1%），且对女性的影响显著更大。除减少就业外，恐怖主义还促使劳动者从正规就业和现金支付岗位转移，并导致销售、服务业及非熟练体力劳动岗位的就业下降。研究结果表明，劳动力市场紊乱是发展中国家不安全局势的重要经济代价。

title: On the Benefits of Robo-Advice in Financial Markets
title_zh: 论机器人投顾在金融市场中的益处
title_primary: 论机器人投顾在金融市场中的益处
title_secondary: On the Benefits of Robo-Advice in Financial Markets
authors: Marco Lambrecht, Joerg Oechssler, Simon Weidenholzer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Robo-advisors are tools in financial markets that provide investors with low-cost financial advice, typically based on individual characteristics such as risk attitudes. We study the benefits of robo-advice in a ten-week portfolio choice experiment. Depending on treatment, investors either receive robo-advice, have a robo-advisor implement recommendations by default, or invest on their own. While we observe no effect of robo-advice on initial market participation, we find positive effects on continued participation. Robo-advisors also help investors avoid mistakes, increase rebalancing, and yield portfolios closer to the utility-maximising benchmark. Default implementation of recommendations performs significantly better than advice alone.
abstract_zh: 机器人投顾是金融市场中为投资者提供低成本财务建议的工具，通常基于风险态度等个人特征。我们通过一项为期十周的投资组合选择实验，研究了机器人投顾的益处。根据实验处理方式的不同，投资者或接受机器人投顾建议，或由机器人投顾默认执行推荐方案，或自行投资。虽然我们未观察到机器人投顾对初始市场参与的影响，但发现其对持续参与具有积极效应。机器人投顾还能帮助投资者避免错误、增加再平衡操作，并使投资组合更接近效用最大化的基准水平。相较于仅提供建议，默认执行推荐方案的效果显著更优。

title: Cultural doorways in the barriers to development
title_zh: 发展障碍中的文化通道
title_primary: 发展障碍中的文化通道
title_secondary: Cultural doorways in the barriers to development
abstract: We develop novel indices of cultural similarity among ethnic groups derived from their oral traditions. We find that variation in these indices significantly affects currently observed pairwise disparities in income per capita, even after controlling for measures of geo-climatic, historical, religious, and linguistic barriers. We also propose an empirical exploration of the mechanisms linking folklore similarities to income differences. These findings lend support to the relevance of knowledge, information and technological transfers across people and societies in the diffusion of development.
